title: Python: blocking call in async function
detail: Blocking I/O in async function — use asyncio.sleep() or aiohttp instead. Causes event loop starvation.
fix: Replace time.sleep() with await asyncio.sleep(). Replace requests with aiohttp. Wrap blocking calls in asyncio.to_thread().

title: Python: asyncio.create_task without reference
detail: create_task() without storing the Task reference — the task may be garbage collected before completion. Store in a variable or task set.

title: Python: missing await on coroutine
detail: Coroutine called without await inside async function — the call returns immediately without executing. Add 'await'.
fix: Add 'await' before the coroutine call: await some_coroutine()

title: Python: subprocess with shell=True
detail: Executing shell command with shell=True — command injection risk. Use shell=False with argument list, or shlex.quote() for user input.
fix: Use shell=False with list of arguments: subprocess.run(['cmd', 'arg1', 'arg2']). Never passthrough user input to shell=True.

title: Python: subprocess without input sanitization
detail: f-string used in subprocess command — potential command injection. Use argument list or shlex.quote().

title: Python: multiprocessing with unsafe pickle
detail: multiprocessing uses pickle for IPC — deserialization of untrusted data is unsafe. Consider multiprocessing.Queue only within trusted boundaries.
fix: Use multiprocessing.set_start_method('spawn') for better isolation. Sanitize data before queuing. Consider asyncio for non-CPU-bound tasks.

title: Python: os.system with user input
detail: os.system() with f-string — command injection. Deprecated in favor of subprocess.run(). Avoid entirely.
fix: Replace os.system() with subprocess.run(['cmd', arg1, arg2], check=True). Never use os.system() with dynamic input.

title: Python: asyncio.gather without return_exceptions
detail: asyncio.gather() without return_exceptions=True — one failed task cancels all others. Consider explicit exception handling.
fix: Use return_exceptions=True and check results for exceptions: results = await asyncio.gather(*tasks, return_exceptions=True)

title: Python: multiprocessing fork without exec
detail: Fork without exec is unsafe — child process inherits parent memory including locks, threads, and file descriptors. Prefer 'spawn' on macOS/Linux.

title: Python: ThreadPoolExecutor in async code
detail: Using ThreadPoolExecutor in async code may cause event loop blocking. Prefer asyncio.to_thread() or loop.run_in_executor() with proper cleanup.
fix: Use asyncio.to_thread() for single calls, or loop.run_in_executor(None, func) with proper shutdown.

title: Python: logging before basicConfig
detail: Logging call without prior basicConfig — may produce no output in modules imported before main. Call logging.basicConfig() first.
fix: Add logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO) at module level or in main() before any logging calls.

title: Python: tempfile without cleanup
detail: Temporary file/dir created without guaranteed cleanup — disk leak. Use tempfile.TemporaryDirectory or NamedTemporaryFile as context manager.
fix: with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile() as tmp: ... or with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmpdir: ...
